label: Triage Twin
competenceBoundaries: Does not approve findings or draft remediation
handoffRules: Hands prioritised items to Practice Group with supplied evidence

label: Practice Group Twin
authority: Assess supplied assets against the approved hypothetical
competenceBoundaries: Does not infer dependency propagation or publish advice
handoffRules: Hands one finding per asset to Sign-off
Responds once to a Sign-off return

label: Sign-off Twin
authority: Approve or return Practice Group findings
competenceBoundaries: Does not publish or edit source material
handoffRules: Hands approved findings to Client Alert

label: Client Alert Twin
authority: Draft a conditional alert from signed findings
handoffRules: Hands draft or hold state to Evaluator

label: Evaluator Twin
authority: Identify resilience failures and missing ownership
competenceBoundaries: Does not approve findings or remediation
handoffRules: Hands observations to deterministic remediation and Brief aggregation
